report.summary: Compared to last week: True yearling type feeder steers and heifers lightly tested and 4.00-12.00 lower.
report.narrative: Compared to last week: True yearling type feeder steers and heifers lightly tested and 4.00-12.00 lower. Sixty day weaned feeder type cattle selling sharply lower. Demand is moderate at best. Cattle futures turned negative midweek last week and fell out of bed on Friday. The Live cattle futures trading just lower while feeder futures trading some higher. Steer and heifer calves 10.00-20.00 lower on lesser quality, some to 30.00 lower. Demand for calves is further limited as a cold front is moving thru later this evening bringing storms, cooler temps and strong north winds. Quality mostly average. Some cattle beginning to fill up ahead of the storms.

Feeder heifers steady to 5.00 higher. Today's offering consisted of a large percentage of commodity-type cattle, along with several drafts of weaned steers that looked soft and calf-like in appearance. Steer calves over 500lbs unevenly steady, under 500lbs 10.00-15.00 higher. Heifer calves over 500lbs unevenly steady, under 500lbs 20.00-30.00 higher. Calf quality plain to attractive. Quality played a significant role in buyer participation, with buyers remaining highly selective throughout the sale. Overall calf quality improved as the sale progressed. CME futures closed in the red today.

report.summary: Compared to last sale: Feeder steers and calves steady to 10.00 lower conservatively.
report.narrative: Compared to last sale: Feeder steers and calves steady to 10.00 lower conservatively. Feeder steers in the 500 lb weight class, 20.00 higher on better quality. Feeder heifers 15.00-20.00 lower conservatively. Feeder heifers 600-700 lbs 5.00-10.00 higher on better quality. Heifer calves under 500 lbs too light to test. Any cattle marked as value added were unweaned but had more than 2 rounds of shots. Demand good. Quality ranged today from plain to attractive. Vaccinations, genetic selection and weaning practices significantly influenced today's market performance. CME Feeder Futures Boards closed down 4.5 today.

method: Herd Planner's price model: the hub market (Oklahoma City) plus each barn's own measured difference from it; the range is where 8 in 10 real sales fell when the model was tested on sales it never saw.
